decisions.reason: A mobile check-in app fits the post-COVID demand for contactless passenger handling as air travel recovers in 2022, though uptake by a security-focused firm's clients is uncertain.
PassBoard was a flagship launch building on the firm's core aviation passenger-processing expertise and supports its innovation-led high-end strategy as airports reopen.
Self-service check-in aligns with airlines' push to cut staff costs and reduce contact after the pandemic, so keeping it during the recovery is reasonable despite weak 2020-2021 visibility.
